text: Samira V: quick FYI from the crawler: SDK auth guide (docs/sdk/auth.md) has a bunch of broken anchor links and one renamed section. New faststart sample links to #getting-started-auth which now lives under #quickstart-auth. Not urgent but confusing for devs. link-scan-bot: scan: 2026-03-23T08:12Z - 11 dead anchors/links detected in docs/sdk/auth.md; sample hits: docs/sdk/auth.md#getting-started-auth -> 404, docs/sdk/auth.md#token-refresh -> 404. full: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/3255556789 Diego M: I bumped into that yesterday when testing the SDK quickstart. @Kaitlyn are you the owner for sdk guides? Kaitlyn R: yep I own SDK docs and the translations. I started a refactor last week that renamed some headings. My bad — I forgot to update internal permalinks. I can patch but two asks: 1) keep the original anchor text so translators don't get pulled into churn, and 2) small smoke test for the static site linter because the last PR triggered a heading-lint failure in CI. Samira V: good point. For (1) can we add explicit anchor aliases via HTML comment anchors to preserve old links? Something like above the new heading. Kaitlyn R: yes that works. I'll add anchors where needed instead of renaming visible headings. For (2) who can run the linter quickly? CI will run, but it might slow merge. Diego M: I can run the linter locally and resolve any style failures before you open the PR. Quick command: ```bash # run docs linter ./scripts/docs-lint.sh docs/sdk/auth.md ``` Kaitlyn R: thanks, Diego. Plan: add anchor aliases for #getting-started-auth and #token-refresh, update two internal sample links (docs/examples/auth-quick.md references), and include a changelog note: "docs(sdk): restore legacy anchors after refactor to avoid breaking internal permalinks". I'll open a small PR and tag you both. Samira V: please include the scan link in PR so we can correlate. Also, tag @docs-oncall for a quick merge if CI is green. Kaitlyn R: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/8201 adds and above the new headings, updates two internal sample links, adds changelog entry. Tagging @Diego M @Samira V @docs-oncall for review. Diego M: quick CR now. tiny nit: in one replacement you changed a link to absolute path. Prefer repo-relative (/docs/examples/...) so local preview works. Kaitlyn R: fixed and force-pushed. Running the linter locally now. Diego M: linter output: one warn about heading punctuation (trivial), no fails. LGTM. Samira V: LGTM too. CI is running on the PR. If docs linter and build pass can docs-oncall merge? low risk patch. docs-oncall: oncall here — if CI green and it's only anchor comments + tiny link updates, we can merge. Please include the scan link in the PR (you did) and mention translations so i18n team can ignore churn. Kaitlyn R: CI passed. Requesting merge. docs-oncall: merging now. Will trigger re-scan and notify if anything else shows. :white_check_mark: link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled. Samira V: thanks team. I'll follow up if re-scan still finds anything. Kaitlyn R: thanks all sorry for the churn, will add a short note to the refactor PR to avoid this next time."
